item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a storm, strong wind blows fast over the tin roof of Meena's house in a village near Pune. The roof is lifted upward.
Which explanation is correct?

options.A: The fast-moving air above the roof has lower pressure, so the higher pressure of the still air inside the house pushes the roof upward.
options.B: The fast-moving air above the roof has higher pressure, and this higher pressure pushes the roof upward from outside.
options.C: The pressure of the fast-moving air above the roof is the same as the pressure inside, so the roof lifts only because of its own weight.
options.D: The pressure above the roof is lower simply because it is higher up, whether the air is moving or still.
